findings.summary: beforeSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and create a no-op swap. It is enabled deliberately because the mandatory quadrant-dependent quote-side basis cannot be collected without it on the two quadrants where the quote asset is the specified currency.
